description: This file defines the Order class for the checkout process within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It contains methods for creating, editing, retrieving, and deleting orders, as well as managing associated entities like products, vouchers, totals, and transaction details.
external_files: // Constant or variable indicating database table prefix

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a checkout order within the Opencart platform with methods to manage orders and related entities.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents an order management component within the Opencart platform, handling various aspects of order data including vouchers, totals, and history updates.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order record in the database, including associated products, vouchers, and totals. Returns the new order ID.

methods.name: editOrder
methods.description: Updates an existing order with new data, including products, vouchers, totals, and other order details.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order and all related data such as products, vouchers, totals, histories, transactions, and rewards.

methods.name: editTransactionId
methods.description: Updates the transaction ID of a specific order.

methods.name: editOrderStatusId
methods.description: Updates the status ID for a specific order.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Updates the comment associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an order, including status, country, zone, and custom fields.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Inserts a product related to an order into the database and adds options or subscriptions if specified.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes specific products from an order, including associated options and subscriptions.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific product in an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds delivery/payment options for a specific order product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes options for a specific order product.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific order product.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a subscription for a specific order product.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes a subscription from an order product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription detail.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions filtered by provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Counts total orders linked to a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: addVoucher
methods.description: Creates a new voucher for an order and associates it.

methods.name: deleteVouchers
methods.description: Deletes voucher records linked to an order.

methods.name: getVoucherByVoucherId
methods.description: Retrieves details of a voucher by its voucher ID.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Retrieves all vouchers associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Fetches all vouchers associated with a specific order ID from the database.

methods.name: addTotal
methods.description: Inserts a new order total record into the database with provided data.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Removes all total records associated with a specific order ID from the database.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves all total records related to a specific order, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds an order status change record to the order history, with optional comment and notification flag.

methods.name: deleteHistory
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a specific order ID.
